text.feels_intro: How {name}'s beating bruises feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a hot red patch over one cheekbone, the skin puffy and shiny where a fist landed; a knuckle-shaped graze marks the brow.

{name}'s face: one eye is ringed in deep purple and swelling half shut; the lip is split and fat, the skin over the cheekbone torn open where knuckles struck bone. Dried blood crusts under {his} nose, and {he} smells of sweat and blood.

{name}'s face: beaten out of shape, both eyes swollen to purple-black slits, the nose broken and pushed crooked, the brow and cheekbones split open over the bone; blood runs from {his} nose and mouth down {his} chin, and the whole face is lopsided with swelling. {name} smells of blood and fear-sweat.
{name}'s face: the swelling is going down; the black eyes have faded to sickly green and yellow rings, and dark scabs sit over the brow and cheekbone where the skin split.
{name}'s face: only a faint yellowish shadow lingers under one eye; the splits have closed to thin pink lines and the nose has settled, perhaps with a slight new bend.
{name}'s face: nothing shows but a small pale scar through one eyebrow and, perhaps, a nose that sits a little less straight than before.
body: {name}'s back: red, fist-sized blotches over the ribs and kidneys, warm and slightly raised; no broken skin.

{name}'s back and ribs: overlapping purple-blue bruises spread across the flanks and the small of the back, each the shape of a knuckled fist; {he} holds one arm pressed to {his} side. {name} smells of stale sweat.

{name}'s back and torso: a single sheet of black-purple bruising from the shoulder blades down over the kidneys and ribs; one side of the ribcage looks sunken and {he} cannot stand straight; there is blood at the corner of {his} mouth when {he} coughs. {name} smells sour with sweat and the iron of blood.
{name}'s back: the bruising has spread and faded into broad patches of green, yellow and brown across the ribs and the small of the back.
{name}'s back: a few dull yellow-brown shadows remain over the ribs; {he} stands nearly straight again.
{name}'s back: the skin is clear, with no mark left of the beating.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a red, puffy blotch on the forearm where {he} threw it up to shield {his} face.
{name}'s {part}: dark blue-purple bruises line the outer forearm and upper arm, the skin split over the elbow; the arm is swollen and held stiffly.
{name}'s {part}: swollen thick from shoulder to wrist and bruised black along its whole outer edge; the forearm looks cracked and is held hugged against the body, the hand puffy and blotched.
{name}'s {part}: the bruises have turned green and yellow and drained down toward the wrist; a scab sits over the elbow.
{name}'s {part}: a faint yellowish stain along the forearm; the swelling is gone.
{name}'s {part}: the arm looks whole and unmarked.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a red, tender blotch on the thigh where a knee or fist struck it.
{name}'s {part}: a deep purple bruise spreads over the thigh, the muscle knotted and swollen beneath it.
{name}'s {part}: the thigh is swollen hard and bruised black-purple from hip to knee; the knee is puffy and {he} keeps the leg bent, unwilling to put weight on it.
{name}'s {part}: the bruising has faded to green and yellow and drained down toward the knee and shin.
{name}'s {part}: a faint brownish shadow on the thigh; the swelling has gone.
{name}'s {part}: the leg looks whole and unmarked.

head: {name}'s face stings and throbs, hot and tight over the cheekbone, and {his} ears ring faintly. {name} is stunned and humiliated, blinking hard and keeping {his} chin down.

{name}'s face pounds with every heartbeat; the eye on one side will barely open, the split lip stings with every word and {he} tastes blood. {name} is cowed and seething at once, speaking thickly and flinching when anyone raises a hand.

{name}'s face is a sickening, pounding agony; {he} cannot breathe through the broken nose, cannot see through the swelling, and the room tilts whenever {he} moves {his} head. {name} is dazed and broken, mumbling through swollen lips, cringing from any movement near {him}.
{name}'s face is stiff and sore, aching dully when {he} chews or smiles, and the healing nose feels blocked and tender. {name} is ashamed of how {he} looks and keeps {his} face turned away.
{name}'s face is tender only when pressed, the cheekbone and nose still a little sensitive. {name} flinches when someone moves a hand quickly near {his} face.
{name}'s face feels normal again. A raised fist nearby still makes {him} tense, a quiet memory of the beating.
body: {name}'s back and ribs ache deep and dull, and a hard breath catches. {name} is shaken and resentful, holding {reflexive} carefully upright.

{name}'s ribs and kidneys throb with a deep, sick ache, and every breath, cough or twist stabs under the bruises. {name} is frightened and bitter, hunched to one side and breathing in short, shallow pulls.

{name}'s ribs grind and stab with every breath, and a deep, nauseating ache sits in {his} gut and kidneys. {name} is beaten down and close to collapse, folded over {his} side, gasping, unable to straighten or lift {his} arms.
{name}'s ribs are stiff and sore, catching on a deep breath, laugh or sneeze. {name} is weary and careful, moving slowly and sleeping propped up.
{name}'s side twinges only when {he} twists hard or breathes in deep. {name} is cautious and keeps others from coming up behind {him}.
{name}'s back and ribs move freely again. A sudden grip on {his} shoulder still makes {him} brace for a blow.
arm: {name}'s {part} aches and throbs where it took the blows. {name} is shaken and keeps it close.
{name}'s {part} throbs deep in the bone and the bruised muscle is weak; gripping hurts. {name} is wary and guarding, cradling the arm against {his} body.

{name}'s {part} is grinding, sickening pain that flares at the slightest movement, as if the bone is cracked. {name} is in shock and holds it pressed tight against {his} chest, unable to grip or lift anything.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and sore, aching when {he} lifts or carries. {name} is frustrated and favors the other arm.
{name}'s {part} is only tender when bumped. {name} uses it almost normally.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength again. Shielding {his} face with it is still the first thing {his} body wants to do.
leg: {name}'s {part} aches dully and the thigh feels dead. {name} walks with a small hitch.
{name}'s {part} throbs, the muscle cramping when {he} puts weight on it. {name} limps and winces, careful on the stairs.
{name}'s {part} is a deep, crushing ache that buckles when {he} stands on it. {name} is exhausted and frightened, dragging the leg or leaning on whatever is near.
{name}'s {part} is stiff, the thigh sore when {he} bends the knee. {name} walks slowly and limps after long walks.
{name}'s {part} is only a little stiff in the morning. {name} walks almost normally.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength again; nothing remains but a quiet memory of the beating.

levels: , a hard, flat crack of knuckles on skin. The shock of it snaps {his} head or body aside, a hot sting blooming where it landed and a dull ringing in {his} ears.
where a bruise is already rising. The fist lands on tender, swollen flesh and the ache bursts into a deep, sick throb that knocks the breath out of {him}.

, and knuckles drive into flesh that is already black and swollen. Something gives under the blow; the pain is huge and nauseating, {his} knees sag and a groan is forced out of {him}. The smell of sweat and blood rises from {him}.

, and it is too much. The blow lands on battered, broken flesh and {his} body simply gives up: {his} legs fold, {his} vision goes grey, blood fills {his} mouth and {he} curls up, unable to protect {reflexive} any longer.

stage.medium: The worst of the swelling on {name}'s {part} has gone down, leaving deep purple bruises.
stage.light: The bruises on {name}'s {part} have faded to sore, reddish-blue marks.
stage.recovering: The bruises on {name}'s {part} have turned green and yellow, and the splits have scabbed over.
stage.mostly_healed: Only faint yellow-brown shadows remain on {name}'s {part}; the swelling is gone.
stage.healed: The last of the bruising on {name}'s {part} has faded; that beating has fully healed.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s bruises from the beating have healed.
heal.passive: {text} This is only {his} body's ordinary healing; the people of Skyrim mend quickly, and nobody would think it worth remarking on.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s bruises is gone, but the healing continues.
